carve_outs: excluding Interest Expense in respect of that portion of the PPP Loan that is used for funding Forgivable Uses), plus (2) scheduled payments, required payments and prepayments of principal on Indebtedness (excluding principal in respect of that portion of the PPP Loan that is used for funding Forgivable Uses

Fixed Charge Operating Cash Flow.formula: EBITDA - (unfinanced Capital Expenditures + income taxes paid in cash + dividends, distributions and Equity Interest redemptions paid in cash) + min(PPP Loan Proceeds - (Non-forgivable Uses), PPP Loan Forgiveness)

Equity Interest.formula: Common Stock + Preferred Stock + Warrants + Membership Interests + Convertible Securities + Other Equity Interests

Capital Expenditures.formula: Fixed Asset Expenditures + Capitalized Lease Obligations - Insurance-Reimbursed Expenditures

carve_outs: provided that, such amount shall not exceed the amount that is forgiven pursuant to the PPP Loan program.

citation.source_text: the Debt Service Coverage Ratio shall be less than 1.10 to 1.00

extracted_financial_covenants.definition: as of the last day of the calendar month immediately preceding the applicable date of calculation, the quotient obtained by dividing (1) the Adjusted Net Cash Flow by (2) the aggregate principal and interest projected to be due and payable over the twelve (12) month period subsequent to the date of calculation (interest only periods will be disregarded for purposes of this calculation) and a 30-year amortization period. Borrower shall deliver to Lender such information as is reasonably required for Lender to make all applicable calculations. Lender’s calculation of the Debt Service Coverage Ratio, and all component calculations, shall be conclusive and binding on Borrower absent manifest error.

resolved_definition.formula: (NOI - Normalized TI/Leasing Commissions - Normalized Capital Improvements) / (Aggregate Principal and Interest Due over 12 months + Principal Due over remaining 30-year amortization)

Adjusted Net Cash Flow.formula: NOI - Normalized TI/Leasing Commissions - Normalized Capital Improvements
